faq.question: Is IELTS required to study Law in Finland?
faq.answer: English proficiency is generally required for English-taught programmes. IELTS Academic (typically minimum 6.5 or 7.0), TOEFL iBT, and PTE Academic are widely accepted. Individual faculties publish specific minimum score requirements and exemptions.

faq.question: Can I work in Finland after completing my Law degree?
faq.answer: Yes. Finland allows international graduates to apply for a two-year post-study residence permit to seek employment in corporate law, compliance, NGOs, and international trade.
